reply.text:
I can help, but "clean up" could mean several different things, and I don't want to make changes you didn't ask for. I'll start by looking at the repo without modifying anything.

TOOL: git status --short && echo "---" && git log --oneline -n 15 && echo "---" && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -n 200

Once I see the output, I'll summarize what I find (uncommitted changes, stray build artifacts, leftover files, dead code, etc.). Then tell me which of those you want me to tackle. Anything I'd change beyond that list I'll flag rather than fold into the same edit.
